Nicholas "nitr0" Cannella (born August 16, 1995) is an American professional Counter-Strike 2 player and a former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and Counter-Strike player. He is among the most accomplished North American players, having won the second Intel Grand Slam with Team Liquid in 2019.

nitr0 initially retired on August 14, 2020 to pursue a career in VALORANT after being signed by 100 Thieves, but came back to the game following Team Liquid's restructuring in late 2021. [1][2] He announced his second retirement as a player on May 27, 2023 before returning to VALORANT with M80 on January 4, 2024. [3][4] He returned to Counter-Strike once again on July 4, 2024 upon joining NRG. [5]
